correctness.rationale: Permutation rank two gives permutation character 1+chi with chi irreducible of degree d=n-1 and chi(g)=fix(g)-1. The central idempotent convolution kernel has absolute mass (d/|G|)sum|chi|; chi is -1 precisely on the D derangements and has zero total sum, so sum|chi|=2D. The complement is delta_e-k, identity coefficient 1-d²/|G|>0 by |G|>=nd; its absolute mass is 1+2d(D-d)/|G|. Cameron–Cohen rank-two derangement bound D>=|G|/n and Frobenius equality prove both lower bounds and the sharp-double-transitivity condition; uniform subgroup averaging follows by evaluating the equality-case kernel. Independent exact S2..S6 character counts and complement formulas passed.
residual_risks: Only endpoint l1 and linfty norms, no intermediate lp norms or higher-rank constituents.

value.rationale: An exact operator norm is identified with a canonical permutation-group density for every 2-transitive action, while contractivity of its complement yields a clean if-and-only-if Frobenius structure with explicit subgroup averaging. This is a natural structural classification, not a fixed-size computation.
residual_risks: Only rank-two irreducible standard constituents and endpoint norms.

final_claim: Every finite doubly transitive action of degree n has standard central isotype projection norm 2(n-1)D/|G| on both l1 and linfty, complementary norm 1+2(n-1)(D-n+1)/|G|, with simultaneous sharp lower-bound equality iff the action is sharply doubly transitive; in the equality case the complement averages over the Frobenius kernel.
limitations: Not a classification for all representations, lp spaces, or infinite actions.
